student_learning_goal: I can make $1 in 3 different ways.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make $1 in 3 different ways.
header.character_watermark: Loonie Lou the Mouse in the top-right with loonie pendant. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw 3 different ways to make $1 using coins.
parts.visual_layout: Three blank combo workspaces with one dollar target labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 three-way combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 blank workspaces, each labelled '$1 =' for drawing coins.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_THREE at Part 1: keywords name the combo workspaces dollar task.

parts.answer_key: Any 3 valid combos summing to $1 (e.g., 4 quarters; 10 dimes; 1 loonie).

parts.student_instructions: For 3 combos, mark TRUE if total = $1.
parts.visual_layout: Three combo pictures with TRUE/FALSE circles each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 true-or-false combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 combos: 1) 2 quarters + 5 dimes (T=$1), 2) 1 loonie (T), 3) 3 quarters (F=75¢). Each with TRUE/FALSE circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_TF at Part 2: keywords name the combos true-false check.

parts.student_instructions: Make $1 using ONLY NICKELS. How many?
parts.visual_layout: An empty workspace with one dollar label and nickel drawing space.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 nickels-only workspace for money worksheet, B&W line art. Blank workspace with '$1 =' label. Below: '___ nickels' answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_NICKELS at Part 3: keywords name the nickels answer space.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find $1 with FEWEST coins.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Formative — check $1 combo creation.
